structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: Verified clone reset to POST and single repeat mode, occurrence-vs-base financial storage and shared canonical design-document references.

entries.plausible_wrong_implementation: Clone could reuse the existing transaction identifier and recurrence series.
Installment adjustment could mutate the base purchase total instead of the selected invoice occurrence.
A copied style palette or alternative installment editing path could bypass existing shared Golden Statement sources and APIs.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: Invoice occurrence and historical neighbors have separate projection/readback, with source invoice summary and skip counts tested in real PostgreSQL integration.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: Financial occurrence totals originate from Installment and Invoice rows; no clone transactionId/recurrenceId is reused; default currency from card, not arbitrary UI input.

documentation_consistency.applicability_reason: Reviewed nine changed API, cards, recurrence, UI and Golden Statement documents against executable code and tests on immutable checkout.
